snippet.title: Street Gang Football ZX Spectrum
snippet.description: We swap from the pitch to the streets and look at a soccer game WITH fighting in it.  Street Gang Football was one of my favourite soccer games growing up merely because of the novelty of it, you can fight in it and also you or your opponents can take their toys out of their prams literally and quit playing the game!  Probably not as good and fun nowadays but back then it was so much fun!
